exp1_leakage_nonoverlap.title: Leakage-Control Evaluation with Non-Overlapping Windows
exp1_leakage_nonoverlap.goal: Compare overlapping vs non-overlapping windows under random holdout and LOSO.
exp1_leakage_nonoverlap.status_in_this_runner: partial: this runner produces LOSO artifacts; non-overlap requires preprocessing with stride=window.

exp2_statistical_reliability.title: Statistical Reliability and Model Ranking Stability
exp2_statistical_reliability.goal: Compute fold-level mean/std/CI and ranking stability across LOSO folds.
exp2_statistical_reliability.status_in_this_runner: implemented: fold metrics and aggregate ranking CSV are written.

exp3_robustness_sensor_failure.title: Robustness to Sensor Failure, Noise, and Missing Data
exp3_robustness_sensor_failure.goal: Evaluate test-time degradation under missing/noisy sensors and windows.
exp3_robustness_sensor_failure.status_in_this_runner: metadata only: use saved checkpoints/predictions as base artifacts for robustness reruns.

exp4_calibration_uncertainty.title: Calibration, Uncertainty, and Selective Prediction
exp4_calibration_uncertainty.goal: Store probabilities/logits for ECE, Brier, NLL, reliability diagrams and selective prediction.
exp4_calibration_uncertainty.status_in_this_runner: implemented: per-sample predicted probabilities are saved when logits are available.

exp5_subject_failure.title: Subject-Level Generalization Failure Analysis
exp5_subject_failure.goal: Find hardest/easiest LOSO subjects and dominant confusions.
exp5_subject_failure.status_in_this_runner: implemented: subject_failure_analysis.csv is written per job.

exp6_few_shot_calibration.title: Few-Shot Subject Calibration
exp6_few_shot_calibration.goal: Fine-tune with 1/5/10 percent held-out-subject calibration data.
exp6_few_shot_calibration.status_in_this_runner: metadata only: saved fold checkpoints enable future fine-tuning experiments.

exp7_health_group_analysis.title: Health-Relevant Activity Group Analysis
exp7_health_group_analysis.goal: Map labels to clinically meaningful activity groups and report group-level metrics.
exp7_health_group_analysis.status_in_this_runner: metadata only: predictions.csv can be remapped later for group metrics.
